sources.title: AMS1117-5.0
sources.ref: Advanced Monolithic Systems DS1117. Features: operates down to 1 V dropout, load regulation 0.4% max, output current of 1 A. Electrical characteristics: dropout at Iout = 0.8 A is 1.1 V typical (1.3 V max, measured at delta Vout = 1%). Quiescent current of the fixed 5.0 V part is 0.005 A typical (0.01 A max)

sources.title: Dropout knots and load resistance
sources.ref: Assumed. The 0 A end of dropout is 1.0 V, from the features line, not a table cell. rOut is 0.025 ohm: 0.4% of 5.0 V over 0.8 A. The current span of that 0.4% is not stated. iLimit 1.5 A is not a table cell; the features list rates the part at 1 A, so the limit sits above that
